name: cmux.chat.widget/1
docs: A card an agent sends in a chat (a widget part naming this app, plans/cmux-next/chat-widgets-DESIGN.md). The render export gets ctx.props (the part's props, data only) and ctx.widget.key (`<message>#<part>`, stable for the part: keep state that must outlive the app in cmux.storage under it) and returns the card's view. cmux draws it natively in the chat bubble: Text, Row, Button (a row of them in an HStack), Badge, Divider, EmptyState and Panel titles; other views are skipped. At most 14 items show: page longer lists yourself (a page signal and Show more). Clicks run the node's onTap with the app's own scopes. Clients without this app show the part's fallback text.
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
